title: KaraokeParty prop
description: Everything needed to draw one handheld prop and hold it consistently across a set. Prose, not identifiers: every value is read into a render prompt.

summary.description: One sentence naming the prop and its defining constraints.

draw.description: What the prop looks like, independent of who is holding it.

shape.description: Form and proportion. Sized against the character's own body, never in pixels or inches — the generator cannot follow a measurement.

readability.description: What must stay legible about it at cell size.

hold.description: How the character carries it. Each hand on the prop names what that hand does, so a two-handed prop describes both.

orientation.description: Which end leads and where it points, so the prop cannot come back reversed.

rest.description: Default carry when no animation set says otherwise. A brief may contradict this for one character.

carriage.description: How the prop is carried in each animation set. A set left out falls back to hold.rest.

never.description: What the prop must never do or become, including going missing.

hands.description: What each hand on the prop does, keyed by the character's own side. One key for a one-handed prop, two for a two-handed one. Never screen-left or screen-right.

palette.description: Base, shadow and highlight for the prop's main material.
